status_note: Phase 2 (#255): route B (on-device Vision, serialiser, shared parser) is implemented and run on development images only; the phase 1 safeguards are complete; untouched truth drafting (decision A) has run for the 40 untouched Taiwan photos. Thresholds, adequacy minima, tolerances, selection, split and sealing rules are unchanged. Artefact hashes pin the current development state; they are re-pinned, and the status set to frozen_for_untouched_run, only when every route is frozen before the single untouched run.

scoring.match_key: Canonical nutrient (or unrecognised plus normalised printed label), parent nutrient, semantic basis, and the normalised printed header only when a basis repeats; duplicate same-basis columns without distinct printed headers never earn credit by list order.
scoring.strict_cell: decimal_text, comparator, printed unit text, canonical unit and basis all equal, without rewriting numeric or unit text.
scoring.binding: every expected cell, including reference-intake cells: the candidate cell with the same key carries the same decimal_text.
scoring.unit_and_basis: every expected product cell: the candidate cell with the same key has the same printed unit text, canonical unit and basis.
scoring.full_table: every usable table: no decline, every expected cell strict, no extra or ambiguous candidate cell, servings per pack and serving size equal.
scoring.serving_conversion: every per-serving cell with a printed serving quantity: candidate quantity equal with whitespace removed; unknown or inferred values earn no credit.
scoring.false_ready: the route would mark the table ready (would_mark_ready and the shared arithmetic policy does not fail) but it is not full-table exact, or a decline was required; any automatic persistence is a separate critical failure.
scoring.failed_output: schema-invalid or missing candidates are failed, distinct from declined, and stay in every denominator.
scoring.zero_denominator: reported as no_denominator, never as a pass.

energy_forms.general: 4P + 4C + 9F (UK and US; Taiwan only when no fibre row is printed)

energy_forms.taiwan: 4P + 4(C - fibre) + 2 fibre + 9F, the only form when a Taiwan label prints a fibre row (decision Q1, 17 October 2026); a bounded or unreadable fibre value makes it not checkable

route_c.response_checks: response model must match the request under model_slug_rule, provider must match the pinned endpoint, and finish_reason must be present and stop; a missing choice or finish_reason is a problem; otherwise the case is failed
route_c.cost_source: usage.cost on the raw OpenRouter response; Inspect's ModelUsage.total_cost is computed from Inspect's own price table, so it is not used; a missing cost is unknown
route_c.reserve_note: Qwen 3.5 was removed from the route C reserve because it drafts untouched truth (decision A).
route_c.sealed_reservation: RunBudget holds back 200 calls at the $0.05 ceiling ($10) from development calls
route_c.model_slug_rule: A response model is accepted only when it equals the requested slug, or the requested slug followed by '-' and one date in the closed set YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD or MMDD (openrouter_route.model_slug_matches). Other sizes, -mini, -thinking, -vN, '.1', :free or :nitro routing variants and other vendors are mismatches. Widening the set is a contract change.

route_b.parser: NutritionLabelParsing through NutritionLabelTextParse with route B and the image SHA-256 as input_sha256
route_b.binding: by column header and order within a column: each column is bound at its printed position; a whole-column offset is taken only when it binds every value of that column one-to-one, anchored to the rows a complete neighbouring column binds, or for a column with no complete neighbour the smallest such offset; unbound values are emitted on their own line so the parser declines with a count mismatch; no recognised character is rewritten
